integrity: Complete explicit analytic proof and reproducible finite diagnostic program are included. Numerical tests are not substituted for an infinite proof. No independent review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for nondegenerate cyclic centrally symmetric hexagons. The Schur order concerns three half-central gaps, not edge lengths. Historical priority against some inaccessible older articles remains uncertain; there is no independent mathematical validation.
title: Strict angular-majorization law for the Levy pseudo-area ratio of cyclic symmetric hexagons
